zh.title: 聯合航空推出滑雪季塗裝E175 波士頓開航傑克遜霍爾
zh.summary: 聯合航空揭曉滑雪季特別塗裝E175；波士頓季節性直飛傑克遜霍爾贈升降機票
body: 根據航空新聞網站Simple Flying的報導，聯合航空公司近日正式揭曉全新滑雪季特別塗裝，這項塗裝將應用於其旗下由巴西航空工業製造的E175型支線噴射客機。
同步宣布的消息顯示，聯合航空將從波士頓開辦季節性不經停航班直飛懷俄明州的傑克遜霍爾機場，且抵達該航班的聯合航空乘客將獲得免費的滑雪場升降機票。
這架採用特別塗裝的E175客機預計將執飛上述季節性航線，為前往傑克遜霍爾滑雪度假的旅客提供直飛便利。

en.title: United Airlines Unveils Ski Season Special Livery on Embraer E175; Boston Adds Seasonal Jackson Hole Flights
en.summary: United Airlines reveals ski-season E175 livery; Boston launches seasonal Jackson Hole flights with lift tickets
body: According to a report from Simple Flying, United Airlines has recently unveiled a new ski-season special livery that will be applied to one of its Embraer E175 regional jets.

At the same time, the carrier announced that it will launch seasonal nonstop service from Boston to Jackson Hole in Wyoming, and that passengers arriving on United flights will receive complimentary lift tickets for the ski resort.
The aircraft wearing the new livery is slated to operate the seasonal route during the winter season, offering a direct option for travellers heading to the Jackson Hole ski area.

zh.title: Panasonic Astrova IFE 獲 Eyesafe 藍光減量認證
zh.summary: Astrova IFE 獲 Eyesafe 認證；RPF40 達標
body: Panasonic Avionics 的 Astrova 機上娛樂系統成為首款取得 Eyesafe Display Requirements 3.0 認證的 IFE 平台，認證涵蓋 13 吋至 42 吋全系列螢幕。
依據 Eyesafe 標準，Astrova 達到 RPF40 評級，超過門檻 35，代表在 435‑440 nm 波段藍光輻射大幅降低。
Panasonic 高階副總 Adri Ruiter 指出認證展現對先進顯示技術與旅客舒適的承諾；Eyesafe 執行長 Justin Barrett 則強調長程 IFE 需內建更好光線而非事後添加。

en.title: Panasonic Astrova IFE earns Eyesafe certification for reduced blue‑light emissions
en.summary: Astrova IFE earns Eyesafe certification; RPF40 rating exceeds requirement for reduced blue‑light
body: Panasonic Avionics’ Astrova in‑flight entertainment system has become the first IFE platform to earn Eyesafe Display Requirements 3.0 certification for reduced blue‑light emissions. The certification covers the full Astrova range, from 13‑inch economy screens to 42‑inch premium displays.
Under the Eyesafe standard the Astrova line achieved an RPF40 rating, exceeding the required minimum of 35, indicating a significant cut in blue‑light radiance around the 435‑440 nm band.

Panasonic senior vice‑president Adri Ruiter said the certification demonstrates the company’s commitment to advanced display technology and passenger comfort, while Eyesafe CEO Justin Barrett noted that long‑haul IFE needs better light built in, not added later.
